title: Load a config file, defaulting when it is missing
task: Write `Load(path string) (Config, error)` in package `config` that reads `key=value` lines (blank lines and `#` comments ignored) for keys `port` (int), `host` (string), and `debug` (true or false). When the file does not exist, return the defaults (port 8080, host localhost, debug false) rather than an error; any other read failure or a malformed line is an error that includes the path. Decide the failure handling before the parsing so the happy path stays flat. Test the defaults, a full file, and a malformed line.
